preconditions.description: Input consists of integers n, a, b (1 ≤ n ≤ 5000, 1 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ 10^5) and a string s of length n, where s contains only lowercase English letters excluding 't', 'r', 'y', 'g', 'u', 'b'.
k is a rational parameter defined as k = a / b, where a and b are positive integers.

postconditions.description: Output consists of an integer c (number of obtainable job categories) followed by c space-separated characters representing the obtainable job categories sorted lexicographically. The set obtainable_categories is defined as all characters x in s such that it is possible to transform all workers' job categories to x using the allowed operations.

postconditions.expression: all(x in s for x in obtainable_categories)
postconditions.description: Every obtainable job category x must exist in the original string s.

postconditions.expression: all(x in obtainable_categories for x in s if is_possible_to_unify(s, x, k))
postconditions.description: A job category x is obtainable if and only if it is possible to unify all workers' job categories to x using the allowed operations, where the operation condition is: for a selected category x with positions i_1 < ... < i_m, k * (i_m - i_1 + 1) ≤ m.
